name: Tolebrutinib
sort_evidence: Tolebrutinib holds an EU authorisation as Cenrifki (2026-06-19, dossier EMA entry) but the book carries neither Cenrifki nor any tolebrutinib row, and the FDA issued a complete response letter in December 2025 (https://www.sanofi.com/en/media-room/press-releases/2025/2025-12-24-06-00-00-3210238).

trials.title: A Study to Investigate Long-term Safety and Tolerability of Tolebrutinib in Participants With Multiple Sclerosis.
